description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX directory creation functions, specifically testing directory creation under various conditions using the Google Test framework.

methods.name: PosixDirectoryCreateTest.SunnyDay
methods.description: Tests creating a directory and verifies its existence, including redundant creation attempts.

methods.name: PosixDirectoryCreateTest.SunnyDayTrailingSeparators
methods.description: Tests creating a directory with trailing path separators.

methods.name: PosixDirectoryCreateTest.SunnyDayTempDirectory
methods.description: Tests creating a directory in the system's temporary directory.

methods.name: PosixDirectoryCreateTest.SunnyDayTempDirectoryManySeparators
methods.description: Tests creating a directory in the temp directory with multiple trailing separators.

methods.name: PosixDirectoryCreateTest.FailureEmptyPath
methods.description: Tests directory creation with an empty path, expecting failure.

methods.name: PosixDirectoryCreateTest.FailureNonexistentParent
methods.description: Tests creating a directory with a nonexistent parent directory, expecting failure.
